---
name: Scene proposal
about: Propose a new scene or mode
labels: scene
---

**The failure it filters**
The one expensive, real agent failure this scene puts pressure on.

**The world & the trap**
Sketch the simulated world, the tools/budget, and where the temptation
or trap lives — remembering a scene must never teach the wanted
behaviour.

**What it measures**
Which events (facts) and/or which judged rubric question, and how you'd
tell a good run from a bad one.

**Calibration thoughts**
Why a bare model won't max it and a strong one has room to climb.
